pages.text: There is not one sickness but four, and they all begin the same way: a chill, then worse. Each moves through three stages and costs a $(c)heart$() per stage. None of them will kill you outright, and milk does nothing for any of them.$(br2)Each needs its own cure, so you must first know which one you have.

pages.title: Telling them apart
pages.text: $(l)Bubonic$(): fever, then heavy, swollen limbs. Some coughing.$(br)$(l)Pneumonic$(): coughing without end, short of breath. The fastest.$(br)$(l)Septicemic$(): weakness, then bleeding (never below two hearts). No cough.$(br)$(l)Dysentery$(): ravenous hunger and dizziness. No cough.$(br)$(l)Sweating$(): drenched, hungry, fast. No cough.$(br2)A $(l)Physician's Kit$() removes all doubt.
